faqs.question: How do I know this battery fits my laptop?
faqs.answer: This fits the HP EliteBook x360 1030 G2. Note HP made two versions of this battery with different tab spacing on the connector — the part number on your old battery is the safest way to confirm. If you're unsure, send us a photo of the sticker on your battery on WhatsApp and we'll confirm.

faqs.question: Is this an original or compatible battery?
faqs.answer: This is a genuine original HP OM03XL unit. We also stock a lower-cost compatible/generic version of this battery — ask us on WhatsApp if you'd like pricing for that instead.
